channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: বাংলাদেশ ও আফগানিস্তান ক্রিকেট ম্যাচ নিয়ে সামাজিক মাধ্যমে রসিকতা
item.description: বাংলাদেশ ও আফগানিস্তানের টেস্ট ম্যাচের একটি ভিডিও ক্লিপ সামাজিক মাধ্যমে ব্যাপক হাস্যরসের সৃষ্টি করেছে। ব্যবহারকারীরা এই ম্যাচের বিভিন্ন ঘটনার সঙ্গে অভিনয়শিল্পীদের তুলনা করেছেন।

item.title: ১৯ অক্টোবর ২০২৬ তারিখে টেলিভিশনে প্রচারসূচি
item.description: আজ জাতীয় ক্রিকেট লিগের তৃতীয় রাউন্ড চলছে। এছাড়া দক্ষিণ আফ্রিকা বনাম অস্ট্রেলিয়া ম্যাচ এবং আফগানিস্তান বনাম জিম্বাবুয়ের ত্রিদেশীয় সিরিজ রয়েছে।

item.title: হোয়াটসঅ্যাপের সাতটি চমৎকার গোপন ফিচার
item.description: বিশ্বব্যাপী প্রায় ৩০০ কোটি মানুষ মাসিক ভিত্তিতে হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ ব্যবহার করে থাকেন। দৈনন্দিন যোগাযোগে অ্যাপটির জনপ্রিয়তার পাশাপাশি বেশ কিছু সহায়ক গোপন কৌশল রয়েছে।

item.title: ঢাকায় ত্রয়োদশ লিবারেশন ডকফেস্ট শুরু হচ্ছে
item.description: আগামী ২৯ থেকে ৩১ অক্টোবর আগারগাঁওয়ের মুক্তিযুদ্ধ জাদুঘরে ১৩তম আন্তর্জাতিক প্রামাণ্য চলচ্চিত্র উৎসব অনুষ্ঠিত হবে। ১৮৮টি সিনেমা থেকে বাছাই করা ১৭টি ছবি এই আয়োজনে প্রদর্শিত হবে।

item.title: কলেরার টিকা নিয়ে বাংলাদেশি বিজ্ঞানীকে নিয়ে বিল গেটসের ভিডিও
item.description: প্রযুক্তি উদ্যোক্তা বিল গেটস গত ৭ অক্টোবর সামাজিক মাধ্যমে একটি ভিডিও প্রকাশ করেছেন। ওই ভিডিওতে তিনি কলেরার টিকা এবং সংশ্লিষ্ট গবেষণার বিষয়ে আলোচনা করেছেন।

item.title: ব্যায়াম পরবর্তী পুষ্টির জন্য কটেজ চিজ ও আনারস
item.description: শারীরিক পরিশ্রম বা ব্যায়ামের পর পেশি গঠনে কটেজ চিজের আমিষ এবং আনারসের শর্করা বেশ উপকারী। এই দুটি উপাদানের সমন্বয়ে তৈরি খাবার পুষ্টির চাহিদা মেটাতে সাহায্য করে।

item.title: Andhra Pradesh HC dismisses YSRCP nomination extension plea
item.description: The Andhra Pradesh High Court division bench declined to extend the nomination filing deadline for local body elections. The court stated it cannot intervene after notification and deadlines.

item.title: VOC Port enhances trade routes with South China and Vietnam
item.description: The VOC Port successfully handled a mainline vessel arrival. This development significantly improves maritime connectivity linking South China and Vietnam.

item.title: Pilgrims in Vibrant Attire Gather at Kulasekarapattinam for Dasara
item.description: Worshippers wearing vibrant attire have gathered in Kulasekarapattinam to observe the Dasara festival. Participants donned various traditional costumes for the occasion.

item.title: Kenya Reports Eighth Ebola Infection Amid Broader Outbreak
item.description: Health officials in Kenya have announced an eighth Ebola infection within the country. The newest patient is believed to have had contact with the nation's initial case.

item.title: Farmer Leader Urges Minister Shivakumar to Stop Intimidating Growers
item.description: Kurubur Shantakumar has publicly advised lawmakers and ministers to stop threatening sugarcane farmers. He also suggested officials surrender their pay to aid drought-impacted agriculturists.

item.title: Bengaluru hosts Tiranga March to support detained activists
item.description: A Tiranga March took place in Bengaluru on October 14 supporting CJP members, including Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, who were placed in five-day judicial custody. The event was part of nationwide demonstrations in solidarity with the detained protesters.

item.title: CISF Plans Major Restructuring of Operations Effective November 1
item.description: The security force will restructure its administrative and operational framework starting November 1. This change is designed to enhance specialized protection for key infrastructure sites.

item.title: Kerala Families Seek Political Backing Over Generic SMA Treatment
item.description: Families of children with SMA in Kerala are lobbying politicians regarding worries about a generic medication. Opposition leader Pinarayi Vijayan wrote to Health Minister K. Muraleedharan to demand action on efficacy concerns.

item.title: IIT Palakkad Organizes 48-Member Delegation Trip to Uttar Pradesh
item.description: An institution-led group of 48 students from Kerala is traveling to Uttar Pradesh. The delegation includes equal numbers of male and female students, accompanied by five staff members.

item.title: KSSP Plans Public Health Awareness Initiatives Across Kerala
item.description: KSSP is organizing public health campaigns throughout Kerala in response to rising healthcare expenses. Seminar attendees noted that an aging demographic and higher rates of lifestyle illnesses are driving up medical costs.

item.title: Private Images Posted Online Following Messaging Account Compromise
item.description: Private pictures of a woman appeared on pornographic websites after her messaging profile was hacked. She had previously sent the intimate media to a male friend she planned to marry.

item.title: Iranian legislature confirms Mehrdad Akhlaqi as new Defense Minister
item.description: Mehrdad Akhlaqi Ketabchi takes over the Defense Ministry, succeeding interim head Majid Ebn al-Reza following the death of Aziz Nasirzadeh in February strikes.

item.title: Karnataka broadens digital RTI access across civic centers
item.description: Online RTI application services have been expanded to all Bengaluru One, Karnataka One, and Grama One facilities. Under the Sakala Services Act, officials must upload physically or postal-submitted requests to the portal within 48 hours.

item.title: Congress Prioritises Graduate MLC Polls
item.description: Treating the upcoming graduate MLC elections as a major prestige issue, the Congress party has announced its candidates well ahead of opponents like the BRS and BJP. The party's core strategy places a strong emphasis on maximizing voter registration.

item.title: Precious metal items donated to Ahobilam temple
item.description: A gold Lakshmi Haram and a silver Shatagopam were presented as offerings to the Ahobilam Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy temple.

item.title: Chinese goods, ranging from vehicles to power storage, maintain high import volumes.
item.description: Inbound shipments of various products from China, spanning automobiles and energy storage units, continue to surge strongly.

item.title: Legislator inaugurates new surveillance cameras in east zone
item.description: A TVK Member of Legislative Assembly has officially deployed new CCTV surveillance systems within the eastern constituency.

item.title: Russian satellite tracks US commercial radar spacecraft
item.description: The Russian spacecraft Cosmos-2612 has altered its orbital path multiple times to near ICEYE-X36, a US-registered commercial radar imaging satellite. The operator of the targeted satellite currently provides data services to Ukraine.

item.title: IUML leader stresses modernization of political strategies
item.description: Sadiq Ali Shihab Thangal emphasized that political and organizational methods must adapt to contemporary shifts. He delivered these remarks while opening a two-day leadership gathering in Guruvayur on Sunday.

item.title: Thiruvananthapuram airport schedules five-hour flight suspension
item.description: Flight operations at Thiruvananthapuram airport will be temporarily halted for a duration of five hours on October 20.

item.title: SITAM groups secure highest honors at Rasthriya Innovation Challenge
item.description: Participants from SITAM captured the principal awards during the Rasthriya Innovation Challenge competition.

item.title: Annamayya district tomato farmers block roads amid steep price drop
item.description: Frustrated growers in Annamayya district blocked roads after prices dropped to 300 rupees per 18-kilogram box at the Gurramkonda market, lagging behind nearby regions.

item.title: Thiruvananthapuram civic body criticized over building permit backlog
item.description: The Thiruvananthapuram Corporation administration is facing criticism from the public due to slow processing and delays in approving building permits.

item.title: Macron promises accountability for those attempting to undermine the French state
item.description: Following civil unrest, the French president condemned the extreme violence. He attributed the disturbances to criminals alongside radical far-left agitators.

item.title: Delhi voter audit errors, police detentions, and other morning updates
item.description: A public audit at two polling stations revealed over 100 voters were incorrectly documented in the Delhi SIR. Additionally, authorities detained the parents of Sahil Wakode from a demonstration.

item.title: Telangana undertakes shrine expansion projects totaling 2,500 crore rupees
item.description: Official Bhatti Vikramarka announced that religious shrine infrastructure improvements valued at 2,500 crore rupees are currently active throughout Telangana.

item.title: Somali maritime piracy resurfaces amid heightened monitoring and family ties
item.description: Anti-piracy enforcement measures off the coast of Somalia have created severe livelihood challenges for local fishermen.

item.title: Shastri advises managing Bumrah's workload and backs Shami and Kumar for T20s
item.description: Former cricketer Ravi Shastri suggested limiting Jasprit Bumrah's appearances across all international formats. Ahead of India's October 22 New Zealand tour, he also supported including Bhuvneshwar Kumar and Mohammed Shami in the T20 squad.

item.title: Jacqui Lambie denounces One Nation cartoon mocking her health
item.description: Independent senator Jacqui Lambie condemned a One Nation animated video that ridiculed her medical condition. Fellow crossbencher Monique Ryan expressed support for her.

item.title: Reports indicate Putin suggests a three-way meeting with Trump and Xi on Ukraine
item.description: According to media reports, Russian leader Vladimir Putin has suggested organizing a three-way conference involving Donald Trump and Xi Jinping to address the conflict in Ukraine.

item.title: Music organization warns AI developers are utilizing Kylie Minogue tracks
item.description: A publishing association reported that artificial intelligence systems have already processed tracks by Australian artists without authorization. The group also cautioned that technology corporations are pressuring Canberra to weaken local legislation.

item.title: Taylor Swift and Este Haim attend Chiefs game to support Travis Kelce
item.description: Pop star Taylor Swift attended a football match between the Chiefs and LA Chargers to support Travis Kelce. She sat with friends including Este Haim, alongside Travis's mother Donna Kelce and manager Aaron.

item.title: কানাডার ঘাঁটিতে আগুন, নাশকতা নেই
item.description: কানাডার একটি সামরিক ঘাঁটিতে উচ্চ-মাত্রার যুদ্ধ প্রশিক্ষণের সময় গোলাবারুদ ব্যবহারের ফলে অগ্নিকাণ্ডের ঘটনা ঘটে। এই দুর্ঘটনায় ৪৩ জন হতাহত হলেও এর পেছনে কোনো নাশকতার প্রমাণ পাওয়া যায়নি।

item.title: Victorian Labor pledges weekly public transport fare cap
item.description: Premier Ben Carroll announced a proposed two-year cap of $30 per week on public transport in Victoria starting January 1, contingent on re-election. Meanwhile, the Greens advocate for entirely free travel.

item.title: Soubin Shahir revealed as Dani in Bachelor Party D’eux
item.description: A new character poster for the film 'Bachelor Party D’eux' showcases Soubin Shahir as Dani holding a firearm. The Amal Neerad-directed project highlights an action-packed style through this initial reveal.

item.title: Two men discuss underground anti-Putin sabotage inside Russia
item.description: Two individuals have spoken about their clandestine efforts inside Russia to aid Ukrainian intelligence during the ongoing conflict. Their accounts shed light on secretive domestic resistance operations.

item.title: Protesters clash with police and break windows in Milan
item.description: Demonstrators in Milan engaged in physical altercations with law enforcement officers and broke windows. Video footage captured widespread disorder during the street unrest.

item.title: Eric Dane’s addiction struggles led to his Grey’s Anatomy exit
item.description: Actor Eric Dane disclosed in a memoir that his struggles with addiction and relapses while playing Dr. Mark Sloan contributed to his character being written off 'Grey’s Anatomy'.

item.title: Dune 3 and Avengers: Doomsday face off for December 2026 release
item.description: Fans are counting down to the December 18, 2026 box office clash between 'Dune: Part Three' and 'Avengers: Doomsday'. 'Dune: Part Three' has already locked down exclusive IMAX screenings for its debut.

item.title: Babar Azam Reaches 355th International Appearance
item.description: During his 355th international match against Sri Lanka, Babar Azam joined a select group alongside Inzamam-ul-Haq and Javed Miandad. He was dismissed for 45 runs after being caught by Pavan Rathnayake off the bowling of Eshan Malinga.

item.title: Pakistan Cricket Team to Wear Pink Kits for Breast Cancer
item.description: The Pakistan Cricket Board announced that players will wear bright pink uniforms on October 25 to promote breast cancer awareness during an ODI fixture. Opponents England and other participants will display pink ribbons, and the venue will use pink-branded stumps.

item.title: Bus Passengers in England Face £100 Penalties for Loud Audio
item.description: Individuals playing loud audio on English buses risk receiving financial penalties under new guidelines. Concurrently, a fresh initiative is rolling out on rail networks urging travelers to be considerate of their noise levels.

item.title: Iranian Foreign Minister Claims Netanyahu Pursues Further Conflict
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that Israeli leader Benjamin Netanyahu is attempting to escalate hostilities ahead of upcoming elections. Meanwhile, military clashes have intensified in Yemen.

item.title: Actors Present During Shooting Incident Involving Tiger Shroff
item.description: Fellow players including Aparshakti and Abhimanyu were present when motorcyclists fired at Tiger Shroff's vehicle departing a Juhu football match on Sunday evening. The attack left the driver slightly injured and a staff member wounded, while Shroff remained unharmed.

item.title: Austrian Airlines Flight Diverts to Bulgaria Following Threat
item.description: An Austrian Airlines aircraft operating flight OS82 made an unplanned landing in Sofia, Bulgaria. Bulgarian officials confirmed the decision was taken by the flight deck after receiving a bomb threat.

item.title: Guide to Understanding Netgear Router Indicator Lights
item.description: Netgear wireless devices feature various status LEDs that can be difficult to interpret. Certain symbols are self-explanatory, whereas others require manual reference to determine their significance.

item.title: Tiger Shroff Returns Home Under Police Guard After Juhu Attack
item.description: Actor Tiger Shroff was escorted to his residence by police officers after unidentified gunmen fired three rounds at his vehicle in Mumbai's Juhu area on October 18, 2026. Although Shroff escaped uninjured following a football match, his driver sustained minor injuries.

item.title: Trump Blames Zelenskyy for Conflict and Defends Russia Sanction Exemptions
item.description: US leader Donald Trump renewed criticism against Volodymyr Zelenskyy, claiming the Ukrainian counterpart prolongs the fighting. These comments follow ongoing debates regarding American measures involving Moscow, such as certain sanction waivers.

item.title: Film Jailer 2 Pulls in Rs 56 Crore on Day Four and Surpasses Rs 424 Crore Globally
item.description: Rajinikanth's latest movie 'Jailer 2' achieved strong box office results, collecting Rs 55.85 crore net domestically on its fourth day. This represents an 18.2% jump from Saturday, bringing total domestic net earnings to Rs 199.90 crore.

item.title: Ukrainian Steel Executive Argues European Union Trade Penalties Against China Harm Ukraine
item.description: The head of a major Ukrainian steel producer stated that the nation has been unfairly grouped into European Union trade restrictions designed to limit inexpensive imports.

item.title: Movie Ranabaali Secures Rs 7.50 Crore Domestically on Day Three
item.description: The feature film 'Ranabaali', starring Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna, experienced a slight Sunday box office boost. Domestic net earnings reached Rs 7.50 crore, lifting the three-day Indian total to Rs 24.05 crore.

item.title: Train Passengers Using Loudspeaker on Phones Face Potential Fines and Prison Time
item.description: Commuters using speakerphones inside trains could face legal penalties, including fines and imprisonment. Authorities are enforcing rules against disruptive audio usage during rail travel.

item.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Romance Features Spark Debate Over Virtual Fidelity
item.description: Upcoming game Grand Theft Auto VI features mechanics allowing players to develop romantic bonds with virtual characters. While some users embrace the feature, others question the boundaries of relationships with fictional entities.

item.title: ‘Serious incident’ at Alberta military base causes deaths and injuries, Canada officials say
item.description: As reported by The Guardian, Patients being taken to hospitals in Edmonton as Wainwright ‘completely overwhelmed’ by number of injuries, local doctor states People have been killed and injured after an incident at one of Canada’s busiest military training bases in Alberta caused a large fi….
